FX-DMAP-001.says: As added: no layer named, so nothing moves.

FX-DMAP-002.says: The grey ramp as the map, red across and green down, both at most 2: column 0, black, reads 2 left and 2 up, column 15, white, 2 right and 2 down, and between them in step. The ramp layer is moved, scaled and switched off, none of which the map reads.

FX-DMAP-003.says: A white solid: every pixel reads the one 2 right and 2 below, so the picture moves 2 left and 2 up and clear comes in at the right and the bottom.

FX-DMAP-004.says: A black solid: the picture moves 2 right and 2 down.

FX-DMAP-005.says: The white solid with both maxima -2: as FX-DMAP-004.

FX-DMAP-006.says: The black solid, across Full and down Off, both at most 2: the picture moves 2 left, whatever the map, and not up or down.

FX-DMAP-007.says: The ramp, both directions Off: nothing moves.

FX-DMAP-008.says: A painted map of greens and blues, blue across at most 2.5 and luminance down at most 1.5.

FX-DMAP-009.says: The painted map, hue across and saturation down, both at most 2.

FX-DMAP-010.says: The painted map, lightness across at most -2 and red down at most 1.5.

FX-DMAP-011.says: A white map clear at the top and more covering down each row, red and green, at most 2: row 0 does not move, since a clear map moves nothing, and each row lower moves more, up and to the left.

FX-DMAP-012.says: The same map, alpha both ways: row 0, clear, reads 2 left and 2 up, so it is clear itself; the bottom row, nearly covered, reads nearly 2 right and 2 down.

FX-DMAP-013.says: FX-DMAP-003 with Wrap on: the picture moves 2 left and 2 up, and what leaves at the left and the top comes back at the right and the bottom.

FX-DMAP-014.says: A 4 by 2 checker of white and black as the map, centred, at most 2: only the eight pixels it covers, columns 6 to 9 of rows 4 and 5, move.

FX-DMAP-015.says: The checker tiled: its pattern repeated over the whole layer.

FX-DMAP-016.says: The checker stretched to 16 by 10, softened between its squares.

FX-DMAP-017.says: The holder names itself, at most 2: its own colours move it; the clear corner, a clear map, does not move.

FX-DMAP-018.says: Across keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 4 at frame 4, down 0, with the ramp: frame 0 does not move, frame 2 moves across as FX-DMAP-002 does.

FX-DMAP-019.says: A layer that is not in the composition, `gone`: nothing moves, and the warning every frame.

FX-DMAP-020.says: A white solid whose in point is frame 4: an empty map before it, so nothing moves at frame 0, and at frame 4 the picture moves as in FX-DMAP-003.

FX-DMAP-021.says: FX-DMAP-002 on the holder moved 2 right and 1 down: the same picture moved, since the map lies on the layer.

FX-DMAP-022.says: The effect on an adjustment layer above the holder, the ramp as its map: the map lies on the frame, which here is the holder's own rectangle, so this is FX-DMAP-002.

FX-DMAP-023.says: FX-DMAP-002 with Wrap on: the same in the middle, and at the edges what is read from beyond one side comes from the other.

FX-DMAP-024.says: Maximum across 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DMAP-025.says: Maximum down -1001, below -1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DMAP-026.says: Maximum across keyed to 2000 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DMAP-027.says: Across written "half", After Effects' Half, which is left out. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DMAP-028.says: Down written "purple". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DMAP-029.says: A fit written "fill". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DMAP-030.says: Wrap written "yes". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DMAP-031.says: A layer written as the number 3, not a word. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
